brief.vibe: A lender's operations floor after hours: graphite ledger, paper coloured type, one verdigris figure, mono row indexes, hairline grid everywhere; sober, procedural, a night shift handover note.
brief.hero: A visible twelve column hairline grid spanning the viewport; the H1 sits top left over a category line ("READ, RECALCULATED AND CITED"), a paragraph and a two cell paper block button with the price in a mono cell; the queue wall of loan rows stands in the grid to the right and rises under scroll.
brief.type: Archivo for words with Fragment Mono for figures, indexes and datelines; set piece is the qualifying income figure rolling through add backs and taking verdigris when it lands.
brief.palette: Dark graphite field (1A1B1D, 232527), paper E9E5DA type, greys, one verdigris teal 4FB89A for live figures; accent never on a button.
brief.motion: Carriage Return and Ratchet easings; a drum counter loader that splits the plate along ledger rules; a first person crane up the queue wall with a held cascade beat; label carriage returns on button hover.
brief.speech: Category line H1 ("AI underwriting software for lenders."); CTAs "BUY A FILE PACK from $2,400" and "Order the Pilot at $0"; sections named "What came in / What was found / What went back", "The ledger:", "The morning note:"; blog titles as bare noun phrases naming a form or letter; plainspoken engineer voice with counting as story.
brief.rhythm: Ledger rows with a four digit row index (0001, 0002) opening every section, tables as furniture, everything on the hairline grid.
